purpose: Test whether the two independently frozen Task14 and bracket programs remain predictive when simultaneously active at L11H3 and L13H8, using exact four-corner effects on each program's licensed corpus.

prior_art_search.result: Each program has prospective transfer and isolated collateral evidence, but no run installs both fixed programs in the same forward or measures their interaction.

design.task14_panel: All 512 licensed Task14 row-by-background cells. Reproduce base/program L11H3 heads, add a deterministic bracket vector at L13H8, and evaluate base, Task14, bracket-stress, and both corners.
design.bracket_panel: All 144 licensed bracket OOD target endpoints. Add the selected bracket vector at L13H8 and a deterministic Task14 vector at L11H3, evaluating base, bracket, Task14-stress, and both corners.
design.stress_assignment: SHA256(row_id + panel cell key), interpreted big-endian modulo the frozen foreign-program key count; no effect or logit enters assignment.
design.interaction: both - own_program - foreign_stress + base on the panel's signed donorward margin
design.scope: active cross-program stress composition, not a claim that one natural prompt jointly instantiates both semantic variables

predictions.pred_a_immutable_programs_and_exact_corn: Both artifacts/results remain hash-identical; all 512 Task14 and 144 bracket cells contain four unique corners; isolated own-program corners replay their parent effects within 1e-4.
predictions.pred_b_foreign_stress_is_live: On each panel the foreign-program marginal has L2 norm at least 5% of the own-program marginal, preventing a vacuous coexistence pass.
predictions.pred_c_task14_survives_bracket_program: Task14 effects under bracket stress versus isolated Task14 effects have cosine at least 0.90, relative L2 error at most 0.40, and sign agreement at least 0.90; interaction norm is at most 0.40 of isolated Task14 effect norm.
predictions.pred_d_bracket_survives_task14_program: The identical preservation and interaction bars hold for bracket effects under Task14 stress.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_price_and_no_refit: At most 20 physical forwards, 3,000 example evaluations, zero backwards, fits, parameter updates, vector changes, or outcome-conditioned assignments.

terminal_rule: composition_screen if all gates pass; interaction_null if instruments and live stress pass but either composition gate fails; inconclusive if foreign stress is not live; invalid otherwise.
closed_claims: joint semantic variable in one natural prompt
